context.transcript:
As you know, in March, our marketing agency won the
industry award for "Most Innovative Television Commercial."
After years of hard work, we're now an established name,
and business is thriving. One of the individuals who has
contributed significantly throughout our path to success
is Scott Williams. So it's with some reluctance that
I'm announcing that Scott has decided to embark on his
retirement. It's certainly a loss for us, and we will miss
his valuable insights. In light of this change, we'll need to
modify a project team. Lauren is already successfully
heading the marketing campaign for the Greyrock Financial
account. So we're going to add her expertise to the Stelco
Technologies account also.
context.transcript_translation: 大家都知道，今年三月，我们的营销代理公司获得了行业“最具创新力电视广告”奖。经过多年的努力，我们如今已经声名稳固，业务蒸蒸日上。在我们走向成功的历程中，斯科特·威廉姆斯是作出重大贡献的人之一。因此，我有些不舍地宣布，斯科特已经决定退休。这对我们来说无疑是一项损失，我们也会怀念他的宝贵见解。鉴于这一变化，我们需要调整一个项目团队。劳伦目前已经成功负责格雷罗克金融客户的营销活动，所以我们还会把她的专业能力加入斯特尔科科技客户项目。
